H2A: Increasing the amount and environmental diversity of OFFICIAL NORMAL CARLAanomaly TRAIN data, while keeping core feature definitions, uncertainty definitions, pseudo-anomaly philosophy and downstream comparison structure fixed, improves transfer of agent-level normality evidence beyond the narrow N=20 training distribution.
intentional_variable: N=20 partial official TRAIN versus ALL complete scenarios in official CARLAanomaly TRAIN
unknown_until: complete verified official TRAIN archive traversal
selection: actual parsed archive order; whole scenarios; no cherry-picking, performance-dependent stopping, town or weather balancing by dropping scenarios
integrity_exclusion_rule: Only objectively unreadable/corrupt required members under acquisition_plan integrity predicates may exclude a scenario. Preserve its ID, ordinal, bytes, hashes, failure and all evidence in a corruption ledger. Model behavior cannot determine inclusion. Ambiguous source/stream failure stops the entire acquisition.

split.timing: ONCE after full complete-scenario inventory is frozen, before any fitting
split.canonical_ID_rule: unchanged strict TRAIN loader identity TownXX/scenario-X; reject noncanonical aliases/duplicates; preserve actual archive ordinal separately
steps: collect every accepted complete canonical scenario ID
sort IDs lexicographically using unchanged Python string ordering
permute the sorted complete ID list once
n_cal = max(1, round(0.25 * N)) using Python ties-to-even
CAL_NORMAL = first n_cal permuted IDs; FIT_NORMAL = remainder
split.N_edge_case: if FIT or CAL is empty stop before fitting; never change seed or membership to fix it
freeze_record: town counts overall and by role
available weather/environment descriptors and explicit missing values
split.partition_hash_encoding: UTF-8 JSON, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), allow_nan=False, containing sorted IDs, permutation, ordered membership, seed and split rule; save exact bytes and detached SHA-256

frozen_modeling.feature_definitions: unchanged Camera, Segmentation and IMU definitions in bound real_features.py
frozen_modeling.one_class_scores: unchanged bound normality.py and real_agents.py; FIT clean only
frozen_modeling.uncertainty: unchanged calibrated member-probability entropy decomposition; total H(mean p), aleatoric mean H(p_member), epistemic total minus aleatoric; canonical units nats; score-space disagreement remains a diagnostic
frozen_modeling.pseudo_role_override: recipe definitions/severities/seed rotation unchanged; recompute CAL pseudo only from new CAL parents; FIT graph pseudo only from new FIT parents under separate graph protocol; never reuse historical pseudo rows
